newsitem.title: USA: Coffee People reduces HQ staff.
newsitem.headline: Coffee People reduces HQ staff.

text.p: Coffee People Inc said Monday that its vice president of development has resigned, and that the company has reduced staff at its headquarters by nine positions in August.
Steven Crantz resigned from the company effective August 15. He joined Coffee People in 1996 and was responsible for site selection and new store development, Coffee People said.
"The staff reductions reflect actions to reduce costs as part of our goal to return the company to profitability," President and Chief Executive Taylor Devine said in a news release.
The majority of the eliminated positions were related to supporting new store development, it said. The action lowers Coffee People's Portland headquarters staff to 22.
"We're continuing to identify additional cost-cutting measures that will not affect the quality of our products and high level of customer service in our retail outlets, " Devine said.

Devine also said that one of the company's Coffee Plantation mall-based stores in Arizona is closing at the end of August, when its lease expires. The company said that the store's closure is not expected to have a material adverse effect on its revenues or income.
Coffee People currently operates 47 coffee houses, Motor Mokas and Aero Mokas. The company employs about 725 throughout its operations.
